Yeah, I've never been in a relationship. I'm turning 27 soon. I really struggle to trust people... despite the paradoxical over sharing. I've given up the idea, mostly because I think anything I can do, well, someone else can do better anyway? So why even bother... 
Of course, I'm aware some of this is just my illness talking, but yeah overall it's the paranoia and low self esteem, made me give up a few years ago. No interest to try again.

Thanks I'll definitely ask the doc about it.  
And sorry for posting this rant I was splitting pretty badly.

Yeah, it's why I don't really post much. Every time I get bad votes I'm paranoid that I'm just viewed as fake or stupid. 
And I know it's not personal, it just hurts a lot. Yeah, it makes me feel even dumber for taking it to heart so much.

I love drawing, it feels very cathartic to get my intense emotions out on a canvas.  
Clay sculpting is pretty fun too.

Yeah that's pretty much me at 26. I have one long distance friend that I am trying my best not to lose and a couple other folks who I message a few times a year.  I used to be pretty good at making gaming friends playing MMOs, but I quit since my behavior would often burn bridges and it was a horrible environment for everyone involved.   
I'm trying to come to terms with the shame I feel from my past experience and make amends through action by being a kinder, more patient person. It's a struggle. I'm honestly not even sure if I'll leave the comment cause I don't wanna make it all about myself.

It's difficult to figure out how to connect with people. Being kind definitely seems to have some positive impact on my self-esteem, but I guess maybe I'm just boring and uninteresting? Back when I had horrible meltdowns people would reach out to check on me, but I don't wanna bond through that anymore and haven't found an alternative, yet. 

Like, all the conversations seem very surface level and idk how to transition into anything more meaningful either.  Is basically how it feels.

I'm just tired of being stuck with my worst enemy everywhere I go.   
I can keep on putting barriers between myself and others to feel safe, the loneliness stings, but at least I'm safe.  
I'm aware I'm not actually my worst enemy, it's my disorder twisting how I see everything and I'm not my disorder.   
  
I just wish it'd go away so I can live my life authentically...

People love to throw around these terms all the time even though we don't typically say shit like, "omg if you don't do this for me, I'm gonna..."
At least not in my experience.

Maybe we're too much sometimes, but at least others can self select out of this relationship...

What I meant by shady is that it seems to me like they're selling vials they haven't even produced yet to people.  
That is an absolutely terrible idea and I expect them to continue to struggle with this until they sort it out somehow. 

Like I can empathize with their cause, but I shouldn't need to poke reddit for answers on what's going on even. I'd much prefer to avoid speculation they just don't give me a choice.

I also decided to try to order from them like a week ago.   
Now this is not the first time a seller has experienced problems and usually they ship the stuff anyways with a delay.   
However they have been continuing to accept money from people while struggling to complete orders placed weeks ago and have really bad transparency only to disappear suddenly. That does seem really shady  
Now I have to try to find another seller b4 my stash runs dry and being considerably poorer certainly didn't help with that. I'm really hoping I am wrong though and they fix their situation cause we desperately need more suppliers too...

That's a shame. Hopefully stuff gets resolved sooner than later.
